title: erodium cicutarium var. subalbidum
intro: Erodium cicutarium var. subalbidum, commonly known as red-stemmed storksbill, is a plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of red-stemmed storksbill include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve diarrhea, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
